thread:
ash: Heads-up — nightly linkcheck errored on a handful of fragment links after merging the TOC rewrite. Failing on pages with nested headings and codefenced captions.
nisha: can you paste the exact output?
ash: sure:
```
LinkCheck: https://docs.redwood.ai/tutorials/migration-anchors#migration-guide-2.0 -> 404 (fragment not found)
LinkCheck: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/zero-shot-templates#example-`prompt-templates` -> 404 (bad fragment)
LinkCheck: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/serialization#json-vs-msgpack -> 404 (fragment mismatch)
```
harper: ah, the TOC rewrite added nested section numbers to headings (e.g., "2.0 Migration Guide") and our slugifier is treating dots and backticks differently. that will create mismatched anchors.
ben: two quick fixes: update the headings to use explicit ids (`{#migration-guide-2-0}`) or normalize slug generation to remove punctuation. i prefer normalization.
linkcheck-bot: opened issue #891: "anchor mismatch after TOC rewrite" with logs attached.
nisha: normalization sounds right. harper, can you outline what slug rules we want (strip punctuation, collapse runs of non-alnum to hyphen, lower-case, ascii fold)?
harper: yup that's the plan. but note: we need to preserve explicit `{#id}` if authors set them. also avoid changing existing anchor ids for stable links. add a migration map for the few broken anchors so external links don't break.
nash: for short term i'll add three hotfixes to the problematic pages: `docs/tutorials/migration-anchors.md`, `docs/sdk/zero-shot-templates.md`, `docs/guides/serialization.md` to include explicit ids. will prefix PR with "docs(hotfix): fix fragment refs".
ben: i'll review the hotfix fast. and i'll add a note in CONTRIBUTING: "avoid inline code in headings without explicit id" until slugifier deploys.
linkcheck-bot: deploy preview for PR #4890 available: https://deploy-preview-4890--docs.redwood.ai/ :eyes:
harper: i'll open a draft PR for slug normalization with unit tests and a small script `scripts/anchor-diff.js` that runs in CI and lists changed anchors so we can generate a redirect map.
nisha: excellent. can we also teach the preview bot to list failing fragment links inline in PR comments so authors can click through? small QoL.
ben: adding that to the preview bot backlog.
nash: one gotcha — the zero-shot template page uses inline code in a heading like `Example \\\`prompt-templates\\\`` (backticks inside text). slugifier should collapse code spans to their inner content, not include backticks.
harper: good catch. will include that case in tests. i'll also add emoji-stripping and smart-quote normalization.
linkcheck-bot: CI rerun scheduled for 30 minutes. will report back.
nash: thanks all — i'll watch the rerun and follow up if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
(ash edited message)
